subject.title: fix(secrets): keep unaffected owners live during reload failures

question: Should this maintainer-labelled SecretRef reload redesign be accepted after a whole-path compatibility and credential-publication review, or narrowed to a smaller owner class first?
rationale: The change deliberately alters credential retention and failure semantics across several runtime owners; neither automated cleanup nor the supplied summary can safely choose the permanent compatibility boundary.

options.title: Review and retain the full owner-scoped design
options.body: Verify the exact head across reload, provider-auth, config-write, and Plugin SDK compatibility paths before merging the complete design.

options.title: Narrow the scope
options.body: Limit retention to the already-proven owner classes if whole-path review identifies an owner type whose contract cannot safely preserve last-known-good credentials.

recommendation.title: Review and retain the full owner-scoped design
recommendation.body: Verify the exact head across reload, provider-auth, config-write, and Plugin SDK compatibility paths before merging the complete design.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged and proposed work in the supplied history makes this person the strongest available routing candidate for the intended reload semantics.
